findings.current: The flame-wreathed spearhead grazed past in an instant.
findings.defect: The translation omits the next two physical images: the spearhead splitting the wind and setting the air ablaze.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly continues with “바람을 갈랐다. 공기를 불태웠다” after the spearhead passes.
findings.replacement: The flame-wreathed spearhead grazed past in an instant. It split the wind and set the air ablaze.

findings.current: Fifteen minutes earlier, he could have blocked it without difficulty.
findings.defect: This removes the source's explicit uncertainty and changes the counterfactual into a definite claim.
findings.rationale: The Korean says “아마 일각 전이었다면”: probably, if it had been fifteen minutes earlier.
findings.replacement: If this had happened fifteen minutes earlier, he probably could have blocked it without difficulty.

summary: The assembled translation is largely faithful, but it drops two source images and makes a probable outcome certain.
